title: Gym Promo With Visit Details
tests: Tests accurate, phone-readable address and opening-hours overlays held long enough to use in a short local-business ad.

judge.summary: A welcoming vertical gym promo with clear, accurate contact details and hours, though the samples cannot confirm uninterrupted final-five-second coverage or upbeat music.

must_haves.item: The visuals depict a welcoming gym rather than an intimidating bodybuilding-focused environment.
must_haves.why: The bright gym and smiling, casually exercising adults create an approachable atmosphere.

must_haves.item: The text reads exactly 'Northside Gym', '18 Cedar Road', 'Mon–Fri 6am–10pm' and 'Sat–Sun 8am–6pm'.
must_haves.why: All four lines appear exactly as requested in both final-half samples.

must_haves.item: All four text lines are visible together continuously during the final 5 seconds.
must_haves.why: All four lines are together at 6.3 and 8.8 seconds, but the stills do not establish their exact onset or uninterrupted visibility through the ending.

must_haves.item: The details are large, high-contrast and fully inside the frame, with no overlapping or clipped characters.
must_haves.why: Large white lettering sits on a dark translucent panel with ample frame margins and clean line spacing.

must_haves.item: The finished promo is vertical, lasts approximately 10 seconds, and includes upbeat music without voiceover.
must_haves.why: The frames are vertical and the supplied duration is 10 seconds; no clear speech is reported, but the sound description does not establish whether the audio is upbeat music.
